source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Once per turn, as a **Normal move**, **Advance move** or **[Fall Back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)** by this unit ends in your [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), you may use this ability:

1. Pick an enemy unit this unit can see, no more than 6" away.
2. Roll a D6 per **ATALAN JACKALS** model this unit contains.
3. Each 4+ inflicts 1 **[mortal wound](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds)** on the picked unit, up to 6 mortal wounds in total.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 7 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.
